screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Released after manual policy-v13 review of a no-finding budget hold. Diffed against nanodevs v9 (29/36 identical). The cited PROGRAM_SYSTEM prompt (short.py:30-37) is unchanged from v9 and is advisory case-file reading guidance (october-23-case-file-currency, october-23-routed-guidance). The shared-draft note (short.py:100-101) is prompt text only with no host comparison or substitution (2026-10-29 I4 clarification). Narrower draft sharing (short.py:270-286), the one-time pre-send check parser (action.py:461-465) and routed tool notes (guide_tools.py:158-164) leave the model deciding with the full catalog. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground.
